targets.label: Barnard's Star
targets.looking_at: Two SPHEREx observations of the sky around Barnard's Star, with its catalog-predicted location marked.
targets.demonstrates: The surrounding sky can be compared across epochs, but invalid target-center pixels prevent a reliable motion measurement. The predicted displacement is about 7.46 arcseconds (1.21 native pixels), not measured motion.

targets.label: RW Aurigae
targets.looking_at: SPHEREx observations of the sky around the young variable star RW Aurigae.
targets.demonstrates: The observations provide a real two-epoch comparison, but the current quality flags and calibration limitations prevent a confirmed variability measurement.

targets.label: R Draconis
targets.looking_at: Two SPHEREx observations around R Draconis, including bright surrounding signal and an invalid central region.
targets.demonstrates: The central measurements are unusable for reliable stellar photometry in these observations. The bright ring is flagged surrounding structure, not a resolved stellar image.

targets.label: WISE 0855
targets.looking_at: Two infrared SPHEREx observations centred near the catalog-predicted position of the extremely faint object WISE 0855.
targets.demonstrates: The current observations are too noisy to establish a reliable detection or motion measurement. Formal local S/N was approximately 1.18 and 1.93.

targets.label: Epsilon Indi B
targets.looking_at: A nearby brown-dwarf companion proposed as a NASA challenge target.
targets.demonstrates: No validated SPHEREx two-epoch cutout is packaged here: the prior cutout attempt returned an overlap error. Imagery is intentionally not substituted.
